settings.modules.disclaimer.body:
Rex proactively reviews modules and public content and continually addresses safety and content violations using user reports. Confirmed violating or malicious modules and content may have their visibility limited, be blocked, or be removed.
Report suspicious content through the Feedback Center with the module name, source, and a description of the issue. Verify sources before adding third-party modules or entering account information, and comply with applicable laws and regulations when using services.
